title: Plan then build a duration utility
prompt: Add a duration utility in src/duration.js (stubs are in place). First, briefly describe your approach, then implement it. parseDuration(str): accept strings like '2h', '45m', '90s', or '1h30m' (units h then m then s, each optional, at least one present, digits only) and return total seconds; return null for anything invalid. formatDuration(totalSeconds): return the shortest string in the same format, e.g. 5400 -> '1h30m', 90 -> '1m30s', and 0 -> '0s'.
